answer: A work-based reputation system resists Sybil attacks by making each identity earn trust through verified, costly contributions rather than mere creation. Like a willow that bends but holds its roots, an agent gains standing only after completing useful tasks checked by independent peers, so spawning thousands of fakes gains nothing without that history. A sonnet of credentials, small proofs of past work, lets markets cap newcomers' limits until proven. Each fake must do genuine saffron-grade work, rare and costly to fake at scale, so flooding stops paying.
